mapper.sql: id, project_id, number, frd_id, frd_number, title, system_code, facets, content_json, delivery_state, planner_comment, attachment_name, attachment_path, attachment_size, development_completed_on, deployment_on, previous_request_id, precheck_json, workspace_base_sha, workspace_head_sha, development_state, development_checked_at, development_sync_error, development_merged_sha, development_merged_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: update builder.adk_builder_project set dev_request_seq = dev_request_seq + 1 where id = #{projectId} returning dev_request_seq
mapper.insert: insert into builder.adk_builder_dev_request (id, project_id, number, frd_id, frd_number, title, system_code, facets, content_json, delivery_state, planner_comment, workspace_base_sha, workspace_head_sha) values (#{id}, #{projectId}, #{number}, #{frdId}, #{frdNumber}, #{title}, #{systemCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{facets,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{contentJson}, #{deliveryState}, #{plannerComment,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workspaceBaseSha,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workspaceHeadSha,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: select from builder.adk_builder_dev_request where project_id = #{projectId} order by number desc

select d.id as request_id, d.project_id, d.frd_id, 'DR-' || lpad(d.number::text, 3, '0') as request_label, sent.id as delivery_attempt_id, sent.delivery_key, sent.response_id as issue_url, d.development_state, d.workspace_head_sha from builder.adk_builder_dev_request d join lateral (select x.id, x.delivery_key, x.response_id from builder.adk_builder_dev_request_delivery x where x.dev_request_id = d.id and x.outcome = 'SENT' and x.finished_at is not null order by x.finished_at desc, x.id desc limit 1) sent on true where d.delivery_state = 'SENT' and d.development_state is distinct from 'DONE' order by d.project_id, d.number

select d.id as request_id, d.project_id, d.frd_id, 'DR-' || lpad(d.number::text, 3, '0') as request_label, sent.id as delivery_attempt_id, sent.delivery_key, sent.response_id as issue_url, d.development_state, d.workspace_head_sha from builder.adk_builder_dev_request d join lateral (select x.id, x.delivery_key, x.response_id from builder.adk_builder_dev_request_delivery x where x.dev_request_id = d.id and x.outcome = 'SENT' and x.finished_at is not null order by x.finished_at desc, x.id desc limit 1) sent on true where d.id = #{requestId} and d.project_id = #{projectId} and d.delivery_state = 'SENT' and d.development_state = 'DONE' and d.development_merged_sha is null

select count(*) from builder.adk_builder_dev_request d where d.id = #{candidate.requestId} and d.delivery_state = 'SENT' and d.workspace_head_sha is not distinct from #{candidate.workspaceHeadSha,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and exists (select 1 from builder.adk_builder_dev_request_delivery x where x.id = #{candidate.deliveryAttemptId} and x.dev_request_id = d.id and x.outcome = 'SENT' and x.finished_at is not null and not exists (select 1 from builder.adk_builder_dev_request_delivery newer where newer.dev_request_id = d.id and newer.outcome = 'SENT' and newer.finished_at is not null and (newer.finished_at, newer.id) > (x.finished_at, x.id)))
mapper.update: update builder.adk_builder_dev_request as d set development_state = #{state}, development_checked_at = now(), development_sync_error = null where d.id = #{candidate.requestId} and d.delivery_state = 'SENT' and d.workspace_head_sha is not distinct from #{candidate.workspaceHeadSha,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and exists (select 1 from builder.adk_builder_dev_request_delivery x where x.id = #{candidate.deliveryAttemptId} and x.dev_request_id = d.id and x.outcome = 'SENT' and x.finished_at is not null and not exists (select 1 from builder.adk_builder_dev_request_delivery newer where newer.dev_request_id = d.id and newer.outcome = 'SENT' and newer.finished_at is not null and (newer.finished_at, newer.id) > (x.finished_at, x.id))) and (d.development_state is null or case d.development_state when 'INTAKE' then 1 when 'PROGRESS' then 2 else 3 end <= case #{state} when 'INTAKE' then 1 when 'PROGRESS' then 2 else 3 end)

update builder.adk_builder_dev_request as d set development_checked_at = now(), development_sync_error = #{failure} where d.id = #{candidate.requestId} and d.delivery_state = 'SENT' and d.workspace_head_sha is not distinct from #{candidate.workspaceHeadSha,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and exists (select 1 from builder.adk_builder_dev_request_delivery x where x.id = #{candidate.deliveryAttemptId} and x.dev_request_id = d.id and x.outcome = 'SENT' and x.finished_at is not null and not exists (select 1 from builder.adk_builder_dev_request_delivery newer where newer.dev_request_id = d.id and newer.outcome = 'SENT' and newer.finished_at is not null and (newer.finished_at, newer.id) > (x.finished_at, x.id)))

update builder.adk_builder_dev_request as d set development_merged_sha = #{commitSha}, development_merged_at = now(), development_sync_error = null where d.id = #{candidate.requestId} and d.delivery_state = 'SENT' and d.workspace_head_sha is not distinct from #{candidate.workspaceHeadSha,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and d.development_state = 'DONE' and exists (select 1 from builder.adk_builder_dev_request_delivery x where x.id = #{candidate.deliveryAttemptId} and x.dev_request_id = d.id and x.outcome = 'SENT' and x.finished_at is not null and not exists (select 1 from builder.adk_builder_dev_request_delivery newer where newer.dev_request_id = d.id and newer.outcome = 'SENT' and newer.finished_at is not null and (newer.finished_at, newer.id) > (x.finished_at, x.id)))
mapper.select: select from builder.adk_builder_dev_request d where d.project_id = #{projectId} and d.id <> #{requestId} and d.number < (select number from builder.adk_builder_dev_request where id = #{requestId}) and exists (select 1 from builder.adk_builder_frd_screen mine join builder.adk_builder_frd_screen theirs on theirs.screen_id = mine.screen_id where mine.frd_id = (select frd_id from builder.adk_builder_dev_request where id = #{requestId}) and theirs.frd_id = d.frd_id) order by d.number desc
mapper.update: update builder.adk_builder_dev_request set planner_comment = #{plannerComment,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, attachment_name = #{attachmentName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, attachment_path = #{attachmentPath,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, attachment_size = #{attachmentSize,jdbcType=BIGINT}, development_completed_on = #{developmentCompletedOn,jdbcType=DATE}, deployment_on = #{deploymentOn,jdbcType=DATE}, previous_request_id = #{previousRequestId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, precheck_json = #{precheckJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, delivery_state = 'SENDING', updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and delivery_state in ('NOT_SENT', 'SENDING', 'WITHDRAWN') and not exists (select 1 from builder.adk_builder_dev_request_delivery where dev_request_id = #{id} and finished_at is null and started_at > now() - interval '10 minutes')
update builder.adk_builder_dev_request set delivery_state = 'WITHDRAWN', updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and delivery_state = 'SENT'
mapper.select: select count(*) from builder.adk_builder_dev_request where previous_request_id = #{id}
mapper.delete: delete from builder.adk_builder_dev_request where id = #{id} and delivery_state = 'NOT_SENT'
